changes: Removes redundant routine SAB mode=version fingerprints from the healthy runtime path after v3.6.29 production telemetry isolated virtually every residual control reset to that probe.

Uses the authoritative current-generation API key through SAB mode=auth for routine runtime liveness while preserving full version+credential proof at startup, reconciliation, restart, and recovery boundaries.
Checks the local provider/configuration signature before any synchronization heartbeat so unchanged configuration no longer performs unnecessary SAB identity work on every engine-loop pass.
Adds SAB identity-probe diagnostics for full version probes/failures, routine runtime-auth probes/failures, and configuration no-op skips.
Preserves the accepted v3.6.29 persistent serialized HTTP/1.1 transport and v3.6.28 Downloads visibility continuity without altering their retry, ownership, or safety behavior.
regression_guards: Startup, port-occupancy, stale-engine quarantine, explicit restart, and authoritative identity-reconciliation paths retain a real key-free SAB version fingerprint where strong identity proof is required.
Routine runtime liveness still performs a real localhost authenticated SAB request when no recent successful API call already proves the engine healthy.
Provider/configuration synchronization still validates the authoritative running SAB before applying a changed or forced configuration; only unchanged no-op passes skip the redundant heartbeat.
v3.6.29 persistent connection serialization/reconnect semantics and v3.6.28 visibility continuity/fresh Queue+History absence rules remain unchanged.
Discover/TMDB, Metadata Server v0.3.3 integration, Smart Import, provider settings, installer/updater behavior, and user data preservation are otherwise unchanged.
name: SAB Identity Probe Stabilization
